segments.name: Contract manufacturing
segments.description: Provides advanced optical packaging and precision optical, electro-mechanical and electronic manufacturing services to OEMs of complex products.
segments.evidence: We provide advanced optical packaging and precision optical, electro-mechanical and electronic manufacturing services to original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") of complex products such as optical communication components, modules and sub-systems, industrial lasers, automotive components, medical devices and sensors.

revenueModel.text: OEM customers pay Fabrinet for outsourced manufacturing services and for customized optics and glass sold in the merchant market.
revenueModel.evidence: We incorporate our customized optics and glass into many of the products we manufacture for our OEM customers, and we also sell customized optics and glass in the merchant market.

changes.text: In the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026, the company updated its revenue category presentation from two categories to three: data center, communications infrastructure, and automotive, industrial and other markets.
changes.evidence: To better reflect our current business profile, beginning in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026, we updated our revenue category presentation from two categories (optical communications and non-optical communications) to three categories: (1) data center, (2) communications infrastructure, and (3) automotive, industrial and other markets.
